title: Japanese Suet Croissant
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and French pastry, where suet replaces butter for a rich, savory flavor.
instructions: 2. Roll out the croissant dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
3. Cut the dough into rectangles, approximately 3x4 inches.
4. Mix the chopped suet with honey and matcha powder, if using.
5. Spread a layer of suet mixture on one half of the dough rectangle.
6. Place a spoonful of red bean paste on top of the suet mixture.
7. Fold the other half of the dough rectangle over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
8. Place the suet croissant on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
9. Brush the tops with matcha glaze, if using.
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
11. Garnish with green tea leaves and serve warm.
